# Lakshie Real Estate Advisory

> Authorized Developer Channel Partner for Verified Open Plots, Luxury Villas & Properties across Bengaluru & Dubai with 0% Brokerage.

## Overview
Lakshie Real Estate represents Tier-1 developers in Bengaluru, India and Dubai, UAE. We provide verified land investments, open plots with clear BIAAPA/RERA titles, luxury villas, and high-growth apartments with complimentary chauffeured site visits.

## Core Portfolio & Developments
- **Purva Sounds of Water**: Premium 5 BHK A+ Type luxury villa on Bannerghatta Road, South Bengaluru. 5,000 sq.ft land, 7,000 sq.ft built-up area, private swimming pool, 2,200 sq.ft private garden, outhouse cottage, priced at ₹9.0 Cr (negotiable, 0% brokerage).
- **Oriaiyan Signature Plotted Layouts**: BIAAPA and RERA approved residential open plots across high-growth corridors (Devanahalli Airport Corridor, Chikkaballapura Nandi Hills belt, APC Circle, Jigani, Tumkur Road, Kanakapura Road). Plots range from 1,200 sq.ft up to 4,499 sq.ft with 100% bank loan approvals.
- **Tripon Nandi Hills Villas & Aero Gardens**: Bespoke 3, 4, 5 BHK scenic villas in Nandi Foothills and modern apartments 5 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport.
- **Vinra KBR Apartments**: Premium residential apartments situated at strategic corridor junctions.
- **Dubai Global Waterfront Estates**: High-yield luxury waterfront real estate under the RBI Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) offering 8-10% tax-free rental returns and 10-Year UAE Golden Visa qualification.
